Version 0.3.0 · November 17, 2026 · Apple silicon (M1 or later)

Install in three steps

01

Open the download

Find overlay-0.3.0.dmg in your Downloads folder and open it.

02

Drag Overlay to Applications

The disk image shows Overlay next to your Applications folder. Drag it across.

03

Open Overlay and sign in

Sign-in happens in your browser and brings you straight back to the app.
